primary_limitations: All balanced ceiling configurations were selected by per-lane public-label cross-run HPO; this is not blind or automatically deployable selection.
D1 retains a singleton cluster with sizes [44,246,227,210,1,479,140,822,145,1045].
Alpha expansion has an independent matched advantage over single-site descent on five of nine lanes and ties on four; it is not universally beneficial.
On tonsil s3, pairwise-zero with stay cost is slightly better than the frozen full result, so an explicit pairwise term is not supported in every lane.
The tonsil s3 size prior explains a material part of the gain, although the no-size-prior ablation still exceeds Night-15E on both metrics.
Only within-cycle frozen-unary monotonic descent is established; dynamic unary refresh means there is no claimed single global energy monotonicity across cycles.
Peak RSS was not instrumented for the exploratory Windows CPU search; no GPU was used.
